## Products
- OmniPulse Audio Engine: Real-time audio synthesis and spectral DSP desktop software.
- NovaStudio Local AI IDE: Ultra-fast code editor with integrated local LLM inference.
- QuantumTrace Suite: Network packet diagnostic and threat detection desktop software.
